title: Reminders
subtitle: Reminders for appointments your care team has approved.
error: We could not load your reminders.
demoNote: Reminders are simulated in this demo. No SMS or push message is sent.

toggle.label: Appointment reminders

onSummary.dayBefore: We'll remind you the day before.
onSummary.morningOf: We'll remind you on the morning of your appointment.

toggle.hint: Turns appointment reminders on or off.

optOut.confirmBody: You will not get reminders for your appointments. Your appointments stay the same.

timing.dayBeforeHint: At 09:00 the day before your appointment (demo time).
timing.morningOfHint: At 07:00 on the day of your appointment (demo time).

empty.scheduledBody: When your care team approves an appointment, its reminder appears here.
empty.offBody: Turn reminders on to get a reminder before your appointments.

cancelled.opted_out: Not sent — reminders were turned off
cancelled.timing_changed: Not sent — reminder time was changed

gotItHint: Marks this reminder as seen. Your appointment does not change.
gotItError: We could not save this. Nothing was changed. Try again.

inbox.banner: You have a reminder from your care team

safe.title: CareConnect reminder
safe.bodyTomorrow: You have an appointment tomorrow. Open the app for details.
safe.bodyToday: You have an appointment today. Open the app for details.
safe.noteBody: Reminders never show results, conditions or names, so they are safe to see on a shared phone.

preview.button: Send a test reminder to this phone
preview.hint: A test notification with the text above appears in about 5 seconds.
preview.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for this app. To get the test reminder, allow notifications for Expo Go in your phone settings. Everything else keeps working.
preview.failed: We could not send the test reminder. Nothing else changed.

preferences.title: Reminder preferences
preferences.offNote: Reminders are off. Your choice is kept for when you turn them on again.

validation.timingRequired: Choose when you want to be reminded.

conflict.title: Your reminder settings changed
conflict.body: They were changed somewhere else, so nothing was saved. This is what is saved now.

saveError: We could not save your reminder setting. Nothing was changed.
